correctness.rationale: The exact three-residue sphere/wedge theorem yields simple connectivity at n>=8; a precise support-face argument classifies every cyclic fixed element and Armstrong gives pi1. The fixed-point-free generator has reduced Lefschetz number -1, and its rank-one/two finite-order rational character gives the complete quotient rational homology. At odd prime lengths the cyclic action is free on a homotopy odd sphere; the multiplicative integral Cartan–Leray spectral sequence has two rows, and finite-dimensionality forces a surjective transgression, giving the full stated integral ring. Independent exact finite orbit checks n=8..18 and quotient Smith forms for p=5,7,11,13 corroborate; no finite sample is used to infer the theorem.
